name: Vidra Hearthstove
summary: Vidra Hearthstove is a dwarven cook residing in the Stoutlager Inn in Thelsamar. Known for preparing local specialties, she frequently relies on traveling adventurers to gather regional ingredients for her famous blood sausages.

sections.title: Kitchen of the Stoutlager
sections.body: Within the bustling warmth of the Stoutlager Inn, Vidra Hearthstove tends the kitchen and helps feed the locals and travelers passing through Loch Modan. Sharing a surname with the innkeeper, she keeps Thelsamar well-provisioned. Her signature dish, Thelsamar blood sausages, is a hearty dwarven staple that requires fresh game meats gathered from the surrounding wilderness, including boar entrails, spider ichor, and bear meat.

faq.answer: Vidra Hearthstove is a dwarf living at the Stoutlager Inn in Thelsamar. She is renowned for her cooking, especially the hearty Thelsamar blood sausages she serves to patrons and Mountaineers defending Loch Modan.

faq.q: Where can Vidra Hearthstove be found?
faq.answer: She can be found inside the Stoutlager Inn, located in the center of Thelsamar in Loch Modan.

faq.q: What ingredients does she use for Thelsamar Blood Sausages?
aliases: what is in thelsamar blood sausages
faq.answer: Her famous recipe calls for a rugged assortment of local wildlife parts, specifically bear meat, boar intestines, and spider ichor harvested from the beasts roaming Loch Modan.

angles.text: Vidra represents the hearty, rustic culinary traditions of Khaz Modan, turning harsh local ingredients into sustaining meals for hungry adventurers and mountain patrols.
For dwarves passing through Thelsamar, Vidra's kitchen provides a comforting taste of home, embodying her staple role in keeping town morale high.
